newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5429/5439 FXSU.
newsitem.headline: Central bank dollar/rouble rates 5429/5439 FXSU.

text.p: The Russian Central Bank said it had set 5429/5439 roubles per dollar as its bid and offer rates for its operations on the currency market on Tuesday.
The official rate for Wednesday will be 5434.
On Monday the bid/offer rates were 5426/5436, with the official dollar rate 5431 from Tuesday.
The Central Bank announces daily bid/offer dollar/rouble rates for its currency operations. The midpoint of these rates is the official dollar/rouble rate for the following day.
The daily corridor for the rouble on the interbank market is 5290/5890 after 5287/5887.
